ruleEditor_hint.message: One "key = value | value2" per line. Click a key above to insert it. No [section] headers. Rules typed here are ADDED to any existing rules for this key (see above) — this cannot remove or override a built-in rule, and for single-value flag keys the built-in value usually still wins.

ruleEditor_status_saved.message: Saved — reload this page to see the rules applied.

ruleEditor_status_saveFailed.message: Save failed — check for a stray "[section]" line or a huge paste.

ruleEditor_ref_direct_hide_selectors.message: CSS selectors hidden unconditionally via an injected stylesheet — no heuristic check, just hide on sight.

ruleEditor_ref_selectors.message: CSS selectors for CANDIDATE elements — only hidden if they also match labels/link_patterns below.

ruleEditor_ref_feed_selectors.message: Same as selectors, scoped to feed/timeline-style containers.

ruleEditor_ref_market_selectors.message: Same as selectors, scoped to marketplace/shopping-style containers.

ruleEditor_ref_right_rail_selectors.message: Same as selectors, scoped to a sidebar/right-rail area.

ruleEditor_ref_post_selectors.message: Same as selectors, scoped to individual post/article containers.

ruleEditor_ref_ad_host_selectors.message: CSS selectors for "host" elements, checked the same way as selectors above.

ruleEditor_ref_labels.message: Text labels (e.g. sponsored, promoted) matched against attributes/context text to confirm a candidate is really an ad.

ruleEditor_ref_link_patterns.message: Substring patterns matched against a candidate’s own links/attributes to confirm it’s an ad.

ruleEditor_ref_attr_keys.message: HTML attribute names scanned for label/link_pattern matches (default: aria-label, data-promoted, post-type, …).

ruleEditor_ref_context_selectors.message: Child elements to pull text from for label matching (default: header, [role=heading], span, a).

ruleEditor_ref_hide_closest.message: CSS selector(s) to walk up to via .closest() before hiding a matched candidate (hide the container, not just the label).

ruleEditor_ref_strip_page_classes.message: Class names continuously stripped from <html>/<body> — defeats CSS-only takeover overlays driven by a root class.

ruleEditor_ref_strip_inline_styles.message: CSS property names continuously cleared from <html>/<body> inline style — defeats JS-set scroll-lock, etc.

ruleEditor_ref_close_popunder_tabs.message: 1/0 flag — auto-close popup/popunder tabs opened by clicks on this site.

ruleEditor_ref_set_constant.message: "chain value" — lock a window property permanently to a fixed value (undefined, true, false, noopFunc, …).

ruleEditor_ref_abort_on_property_read.message: chain — throw when any script reads this window property.

ruleEditor_ref_abort_on_property_write.message: chain — throw when any script writes this window property.

ruleEditor_ref_abort_on_stack_trace.message: "chain, needle" — throw only when the calling script’s own stack trace matches needle.

ruleEditor_ref_abort_current_script.message: "target, needle, ctx" — throw when a script whose source matches needle reads target.

ruleEditor_ref_no_window_open_if.message: "pattern, delayMs, decoy" — block or decoy-redirect window.open() calls matching pattern.

ruleEditor_ref_prevent_fetch.message: propsToMatch — block fetch() calls matching criteria.

ruleEditor_ref_prevent_xhr.message: propsToMatch — block XMLHttpRequest calls matching criteria.

ruleEditor_ref_trusted_prevent_fetch.message: "propsToMatch, directive" — block fetch, optionally returning a fixed fake response body.

ruleEditor_ref_prevent_dom_bypass.message: "methodPath[, targetProp]" — stops a same-origin about:blank iframe from reaching back into the real window to bypass a lock.

ruleEditor_ref_json_prune.message: "prunePaths, needlePaths" — remove fields from any JSON.parse() result.

ruleEditor_ref_json_prune_fetch.message: "prunePaths, needlePaths[, propsToMatch]" — remove fields from a fetch() JSON response.

ruleEditor_ref_json_prune_xhr.message: "prunePaths, needlePaths[, propsToMatch]" — remove fields from an XHR JSON response.

ruleEditor_ref_json_prune_on_set.message: "chain, prunePaths, needlePaths" — prune an object a script assigns directly (not via JSON.parse).

ruleEditor_ref_json_edit.message: jsonq — JSONPath-based field deletions in a fetch() JSON response.

ruleEditor_ref_jsonl_edit_xhr.message: "jsonq, urlPattern" — JSONPath-based field deletions in an XHR JSON-lines response.

ruleEditor_ref_jspb_response_prune.message: Remove fields from a protobuf/jspb-encoded response.

ruleEditor_ref_trusted_edit_request.message: "jsonq, propsToMatch" — JSONPath edits (deletions AND value assignment) on an outgoing request body.

ruleEditor_ref_trusted_edit_response.message: "jsonq, propsToMatch" — JSONPath edits (deletions AND value assignment) on a response body.

ruleEditor_ref_trusted_replace_fetch_res.message: "pattern, replacement, propsToMatch" — regex find/replace on a fetch() response body.

ruleEditor_ref_trusted_replace_xhr_respo.message: "pattern, replacement, propsToMatch" — regex find/replace on an XHR response body.

ruleEditor_ref_trusted_replace_argument.message: "propChain, argIndex, value" — replace one argument passed to a function.

ruleEditor_ref_trusted_replace_outbound_.message: "propChain, pattern, replacement" — unconditional text substitution on outbound data (no URL scoping).

ruleEditor_ref_trusted_replace_script_te.message: "nodeName, pattern[, sedCount=N][, includes=X][, excludes=X], replacement" — rewrite a <script> tag’s text before it runs. sedCount caps how many nodes this rule will ever rewrite (default: unlimited).

ruleEditor_ref_trusted_prune_inbound_obj.message: "propChain, prunePaths, needlePaths" — prune fields from an object passed INTO a native method call.

ruleEditor_ref_trusted_suppress_native_m.message: "methodPath, signature[, behavior, stack]" — abort or silently no-op a native method call matching a signature.

ruleEditor_ref_trusted_suppress_setter.message: "propChain, needle[, behavior]" — drop or throw on an accessor setter assignment (e.g. Element.prototype.innerHTML) whose value matches needle.

ruleEditor_ref_m3u_prune.message: "markers, propsToMatch" — remove ad segments from an HLS .m3u8 playlist response.

ruleEditor_ref_prevent_element_src_loadi.message: "tagName, match" — fake-succeed a script/img/iframe/link load instead of the real network request.

ruleEditor_ref_remove_attr.message: "attrNames[, selector, behavior]" — remove HTML attributes from matching elements.

ruleEditor_ref_remove_node_text.message: "nodeName, pattern" — clear a DOM node’s text content.

ruleEditor_ref_replace_node_text.message: "nodeName, pattern, replacement" — rewrite a DOM node’s text content.

ruleEditor_ref_remove_cookie.message: needle — remove cookies matching a name pattern.

ruleEditor_ref_set_local_storage_item.message: "key, value" — set a localStorage entry (restricted to safe literal values, or the special "remove" sentinel to delete matching keys).

ruleEditor_ref_href_sanitizer.message: "selector, source" — rewrite a link’s href from its own text or another attribute.

ruleEditor_ref_prevent_settimeout.message: propsToMatch — block setTimeout() calls matching criteria.

ruleEditor_ref_prevent_setinterval.message: propsToMatch — block setInterval() calls matching criteria.

ruleEditor_ref_prevent_raf.message: propsToMatch — block requestAnimationFrame() calls matching criteria.

ruleEditor_ref_prevent_aeld.message: propsToMatch — block addEventListener() calls matching criteria.

ruleEditor_ref_adjust_settimeout.message: "needle, delay, boost" — speed up/slow down matching setTimeout() calls instead of blocking them.

ruleEditor_ref_adjust_setinterval.message: "needle, delay, boost" — speed up/slow down matching setInterval() calls instead of blocking them.

ruleEditor_ref_no_eval_if.message: pattern — block eval() calls whose source matches pattern.

ruleEditor_ref_no_webrtc.message: Disables RTCPeerConnection — blocks WebRTC-based popup/tracking tricks.

ruleEditor_ref_disable_newtab_links.message: Strips target="_blank" from clicked links — blocks forced new-tab redirects.

dashboard_rules_subtitle.message: Edit in site-rules.txt format — same syntax as the main rule file. Values are merged with built-in rules.

dashboard_customRules_template.message:
# Custom rules — same format as site-rules.txt
# Values are MERGED with the built-in rules (not replaced).
#
# ── Map a new domain to a rule section ──────────────────────────────────
# [host_patterns]
# example.com = example          ← subdomains matched automatically
#
# ── Add extra domains to block globally ─────────────────────────────────
# [global]
# ad_network_patterns = new-ad-network.com
# tracker_network_patterns = new-tracker.com
# direct_hide_selectors = .new-ad-class
# no_window_open_if = /new-ad.com/ 0 blank
#
# ── Per-site cosmetic rules ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# [example]
# direct_hide_selectors = .ad-unit | #sidebar-ad
# no_window_open_if = /.*/ 0 blank
# labels = sponsored | promoted
# json_prune_fetch = adData adSlots
